name: Kuala Lumpur + Penang, Malaysia
tagline: Petronas skyline, Penang heritage and street food
whyParents: Singapore-style food and skyline for less, plus George Town's colonial UNESCO streets.

costPP.flightsBasis: Estimate. No nonstop from NYC/PHL. Cathay JFK-HKG-KUL out, PEN-HKG-JFK back (open jaw). Cathay route pages show NYC-Malaysia economy from ~$1,034 and NYC-KUL from ~$897 to $1,040 (Nov 2026 and early 2027 windows), no December fares listed. Cheapflights PHL-KUL December average ~$1,818. Mid-Dec peak typical ~$1,450 + ~$80 for a non-Light fare + ~$20 ETS train KL-Butterworth.
costPP.lodgingBasis: KL Bukit Bintang 2BR serviced apartment ~$130/night all-in x3 + George Town heritage 2BR house ~$150/night all-in x3 = ~$840 / 4. AirROI KL Dec peak ADR ~$78 (all sizes); Kayak PARKROYAL Serviced Suites Dec avg ~$90; AirDNA George Town ADR ~$69 (trailing 12 months).

flight.routing: JFK-HKG-KUL Dec 12, land KUL Dec 13. Return PEN-HKG-JFK Dec 19 (CX634 PEN 13:00, seen operating 2026), home Dec 19.
flight.hours: ~21 to 23h each way incl. Hong Kong connection
flight.notes: Cathay is oneworld (AA miles). Alts: Turkish via Istanbul, Qatar via Doha (check Middle East disruptions), Singapore Airlines via SIN. Capital One partners: Cathay Asia Miles, Turkish, KrisFlyer. No PHL nonstop to Asia.

weather.precip: KL: afternoon thunderstorms most days (~250 mm, 18-20 rain days). Penang drier (~140 mm, ~14 days). Monsoon hits east coast, not this route.

stay: KL: Bukit Bintang, walk to Jalan Alor and Pavilion. Penang: George Town heritage core, walk to street art and hawkers.
getAround: KL: Grab, LRT and monorail. ETS Platinum train KL Sentral to Butterworth ~4h, then ferry to George Town. Grab in Penang. No car.
entry: Visa-free up to 90 days; passport valid 6 months. Free MDAC online within 3 days before arrival; avoid fee sites.
events: MetMalaysia: Northeast Monsoon runs Oct 27 2026 to Mar 2027, heaviest rain and rough seas on east coast and South China Sea side
Christmas decorations at Pavilion KL and KLCC malls (annual; 2026 dates not announced)
pros: Superb cheap street food, Penang especially
English widely spoken, easy Grab rides
cons: Hot, humid, ~90F with afternoon storms in KL
Two of seven days lost to flying

itinerary.title: Land KL, Petronas lights
itinerary.plan: Arrive KLIA Dec 13, Grab to Bukit Bintang. Evening KLCC Park fountain show under lit Petronas Towers.

itinerary.title: Old KL + Chinatown
itinerary.plan: Merdeka Square, Sultan Abdul Samad Building, Central Market crafts, Petaling Street. Petronas Skybridge late afternoon.
itinerary.eat: Hokkien mee at Kim Lian Kee, Petaling Street

photo.author: Jorge Láscar
photo.caption: Merdeka Square, Sultan Abdul Samad Building

itinerary.title: Batu Caves + Thean Hou
itinerary.plan: Early Batu Caves (272 steps) before heat and storms, afternoon Thean Hou Temple, evening Pavilion Christmas decor.

itinerary.title: Train to Penang
itinerary.plan: Morning ETS Platinum KL Sentral to Butterworth (~4h), ferry to George Town, sunset Esplanade and City Hall walk.
itinerary.eat: Char kway teow on Lebuh Kimberley

itinerary.title: Penang Hill + Kek Lok Si
itinerary.plan: Funicular up Penang Hill for island views, then Kek Lok Si pagoda and Kuan Yin statue.

photo.author: Flying Pharmacist
photo.caption: Kek Lok Si lit at night

itinerary.title: Street art + clan houses
itinerary.plan: Armenian Street murals, Khoo Kongsi clan temple, Chew Jetty stilt houses, Little India. Evening hawker crawl.

itinerary.title: Fly home
itinerary.plan: Roti canai breakfast, Grab to Penang airport (~30 min). Cathay via Hong Kong, land JFK Dec 19 evening.
